fr_html: XVIII. Les parties au litige doivent-elles avoir le droit d'influencer la composition de la chambre de la Cour qui connaîtra du litige en question?
en_html: XVIII. Shall the parties to a dispute have the right of influencing the composition of the committee of the Court that is to hear and determine the dispute in question?
